scenes.narration: Dad "needs nothing." Every year. Back to the game.
scenes.visual: b-roll:a dad on the couch shrugging at a gift catalog

scenes.narration: Nothing usually means nothing he can think of. So upgrade what he already uses. Stay for the last-resort gift.
scenes.visual: b-roll:a coffee cup going into the microwave for the third time

scenes.narration: Reheats his coffee? A heated mug holds 120 to 145 degrees for up to an hour and a half.
Hates apps? One heated mug has no app at all, just one button and three heat settings.
Carries a water bottle everywhere? A good insulated one keeps drinks cold for 24 hours.
scenes.visual: product:insulated water bottle with a sip lid

scenes.narration: Misses the grandkids? A photo frame the family emails photos to. Load it before he opens it.
Still stuck? Give him an afternoon. Write the plan on a card, with a date.
scenes.visual: b-roll:a handwritten card that says "Saturday, fishing, you and me"

scenes.narration: He still says he needed nothing. The card goes on the fridge anyway. The full list is at the link.
